name: web-email-marketing-portrait-with-glowing-envelope-icons-bokeh
title: Email marketing portrait: a man in an orange jacket checking his phone amid glowing envelope icons and bokeh
whatItIs: A moody night photo of a bearded man in glasses and an orange hooded jacket looking at his phone, surrounded by glowing blue and orange envelope and bowtie-ribbon icons and soft circular bokeh lights.
whatItMeans: Immersive and futuristic; glowing icons floating around a real person make an abstract marketing channel feel like it surrounds daily life.
techniques: Float glowing icons around a real photographic subject.
Use bokeh lights to add depth and a tech-night mood.
Colour-code icon types (envelope vs ribbon) for variety.

vocabulary.definition: Soft, blurred circular light spots in a photo's background.
A digitally added icon rendered with a light-emitting effect.
